annotation.summary_en: A TV reporter visits a remote village in Artsakh to interview centenarians about their secrets to longevity, only to encounter a shocking surprise with the third man.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch opens on a grassy mountainside in Nagorno-Karabakh, where a TV reporter and his crew are filming a segment about the new North-South highway. The reporter explains they are in Kichan, a village famous for its long-lived inhabitants who average 100 years of age. They approach three bearded men sitting by a stone wall. The first elder, 98-year-old Beglar, attributes his health to walking 10 kilometers every night, breathing fresh air, and avoiding smoking and drinking. The second, 101-year-old Mamikon, claims his secret is morning walks and a similarly clean lifestyle. The reporter is amazed until he interviews the third man, Arzuman. Unlike the others, Arzuman boasts about smoking two packs of cigarettes a day, drinking excessive amounts of vodka, partying, and causing trouble for the local girls. When the baffled reporter asks how he survived such a lifestyle to reach such a 'venerable age,' Arzuman reveals he is actually only 26 years old. The sketch ends abruptly when his mother yells for him to come home, and he submissively obeys.
catchphrases: հա բայց ինչ տարիք ա որ 26 տարեկան տղա եմ
ընտե գալուց 3 հատ 120ոց բիձա եմ տեսե
դե մի խոսքով էնքան լավա էնքան քյոքա
